title: At the Café
subtitle: Order with confidence
description: Learn the phrases you need for a smooth café experience, from ordering your drink to asking for the check. These everyday sentences will make you sound like a regular.
tip: Add 'please' and a slight upward tone at the end of your order — it sounds more natural and polite than a flat statement.
phrases: Can I get a medium latte with oat milk, please?
Do you have any seasonal specials today?
I'll have the avocado toast and a black coffee.
Could I get that to go, please?
What would you recommend — the cappuccino or the flat white?
Can we get the check when you have a chance?
Do you accept card, or is it cash only?
Actually, could I swap the regular milk for almond milk?
